get.description:
Which local days (in IANA zone `tz`) have points or Timeline segments, for the coverage
strip; at most 400 days per request. Days without data are omitted.

parameters.description: IANA zone that defines the local days
parameters.name: tz

schema.description: IANA zone that defines the local days
schema.title: Tz

get.description:
The caller's current Timeline segments as a vector tile (layer `segments`; zoom 5 and
up): visits as points, activities and paths as lines, with `kind`, `activity`, `semantic`,
`t0`/`t1` (epoch seconds).

404.description: Tile outside the supported zoom range or grid

503.description: Tile took too long; narrow the date range or zoom in

get.description:
The caller's raw location points as a vector tile (layer `points`). Below zoom 14, and in
dense tiles above it, points are counted into a grid (`n` = points in the cell); otherwise
each point is a feature with `ts` (epoch seconds) and `src`.

404.description: Tile outside the supported zoom range or grid

503.description: Tile took too long; narrow the date range or zoom in

put.description:
Whether a person was on this leg. Core editors set it for anyone they can see; a
participant sets it for themselves and people they manage.

post.description: The honesty notice (PLAN.md §6.7) is acknowledged once.

get.description: Values for `any`, overridden by values stored for the given device class.
Trips the caller can see (PLAN.md §6.2), newest first.

post.description: Members and the Admin create trips they own; Viewers are read-only (D-27).

delete.description: Only the owner deletes a trip, with everyone's contributions on it (D-17).

patch.description: Trip core (title, dates, purpose, visibility, sharing): the owner, or the Admin.

post.description:
Core editors add core legs; participants (Members) add their own legs, which only they
edit and which count just them as travelers unless they add others (D-22).

get.description: Everyone on the trip: trip-level participants first, then people only on some legs.

post.description:
Core editors add people they can see. On a 'participants' trip this shares the trip
with that person's account.

delete.description: Takes the person off the trip and off every leg override (D-81).

put.description:
Public consent for a participant's name, notes, photos and legs (§6.6): decided by the
participant, or for a person without an account by their managing user (D-21).
Body: the raw chunk bytes (application/octet-stream); header X-Chunk-SHA256.
